pictures.author: Huangdan2060
pictures.observations: Three golden overhanging roofs with strongly swept corners, a rounded helmet-like upper roof/ridge and central finial. Dark red timber, open middle balcony and closed upper panels. Red city-wall gate, stone frontage rails and separate green-roofed pavilions are outside the tower footprint.

pictures.author: Huangdan2060
pictures.observations: Close side: deep curved gold tiled eaves with dark undersides, deep red/brown columns and bracket blocks, geometric middle-balcony lattice, upper closed lattice panels, stone plinth and short entrance steps. Independent green pavilion and landscaping remain host context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Yueyang Tower exterior: three decreasing golden curved roofs/strongly upswept corners, rounded upper ridge/finial, dark red/brown timber columns and bracket blocks, open middle balcony/geometric rails, closed upper lattice panels and bounded stone plinth/entrance treads. Four existing shared stone/timber/panel/glazed-tile graphs; original simplified geometry, no copied photos or pseudo-calligraphy. No furnished interior, whole city-wall gate/frontage, adjacent green pavilion, park platform, trees or tourist props.
